basic_steps: Stand with knees softly bent to prepare for pelvic isolation
Engage an offbeat rhythm in 4/4 meter
Execute continuous, isolated circular movements of the hips
Lower the torso forward while maintaining the rolling hip circles to emphasize the buttocks
Return the torso upright while keeping the circular pelvic rhythm uninterrupted

teaching.rhythm: 4/4 offbeat-accented rhythm, frequently overlaid with counter-rhythms
